name: Mouri Sonken
source:
"I'll show you my knowledge" 

 The executive of Three Nations School. Due to his brilliant mind, he is known as "The Wise Sage". Head over heels in love with Michiru. 

 Battle quote - "My goodness... what a fool."
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
